svg.title: 从 URL 到网页显示的完整时序与地址变化
svg.desc: 六条生命线展示电脑、NAT 网关、互联网多跳路径、DNS 解析器、DNS 权威体系和网站服务器。包括 ARP、DNS、TCP、TLS、HTTP、渲染与后续请求，标注 IP、端口和逐跳 MAC。

text.tspan: ① 准备查询外网 DNS：先查路由表

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: ARP 直接承载在以太网中，没有 TCP/UDP 端口

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: ② DNS：查询 shop.example.com 的 A 记录

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 普通 IP 转发：地址和端口通常不变

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: TTL 逐跳递减，每个路由跳点重新封装

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 以太网目的 MAC 是当前下一跳

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 电脑 MAC 不传到远端

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 解析器用自己的 IP 和临时端口发起新 DNS 查询

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: ③ TCP 三次握手：建立到网站 443 端口的连接

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: ④ 以下 TLS / HTTP 箭头表示端到端逻辑交互，实际仍经过 G 和 N

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 出站：C → GL；GW → I；中间逐跳转发；RS → S

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 返回：S → RS；中间逐跳转发；I → GW；GL → C

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 持续复用上述 TCP 端口和 NAT 映射

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: TLS 保护后续 HTTP 数据

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 外层 IP 地址、TCP 端口仍用于转发和连接识别

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: ⑤ HTTP/2：完成连接初始化后，请求商品页面

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 不随 HTTP 请求发送

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 较大的响应分成多个 TCP 段；TCP 负责确认、排序和必要的重传

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 每段仍按 IP → 链路帧 → 物理信号传输，不要求与 HTTP/2 帧边界对齐

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: ⑥ 解析 HTML 时发现其他资源，复用同一 TCP / TLS 连接
